episode_summary: Julia Hurley shares her journey from being voted out of her own company to building a successful real estate brokerage. She emphasizes the importance of resilience, quality lead generation, and providing value to clients. Julia also discusses her foray into athlete management and offers actionable tactics for agents to grow their business using free tools and strategic networking.
